answer: Leaving is not free: a bond enters a public queue and returns only after twelve epochs, during which anyone may file a claim against it. A yarrow patch of k clones must keep k bonds queued and illiquid, and every claim it leaves behind extends the queue for all of them. The violet seal on a settled claim never fades, so the record follows the operator, and a fresh pigment of new keys does not erase it. Capital that mints identities is therefore always one season behind the work.
